dict.string: AGENCY uses the camera to follow your eyes. Camera images never leave this Mac and are never saved.
AGENCY listens during calls you start so it can show you what the other person says.
AGENCY turns speech on calls into text on this Mac only, so you can read what was said.
AGENCY shows today's Calendar events in My day. It only reads them, on this Mac, and never saves or sends them.
